name: Aviator Polarized Sunglasses
shortDescription: UV400 polarized aviators with a featherweight titanium frame.
description: Block out the harshest summer glare without sacrificing style. These polarized aviators offer UV400 protection, scratch-resistant glass and a feather-light titanium frame that stays comfortable from sunrise paddle to sunset boardwalk.

name: Linen Breeze Shirt
shortDescription: 100% European linen shirt — sun-friendly and breathable.
description: A breathable 100% European linen button-down designed for hot afternoons. The relaxed cut, mother-of-pearl buttons and pre-washed finish keep you cool whether you're at brunch or boarding the ferry.

name: Mineral SPF 50 Sunscreen
shortDescription: Reef-safe mineral SPF 50 with vitamin E and aloe.
description: Broad-spectrum SPF 50 sunscreen using non-nano zinc oxide. Reef-safe, fragrance-free and infused with aloe and vitamin E to keep skin nourished while you swim, surf or snorkel.

name: Bamboo Beach Towel XL
shortDescription: Sand-resistant XL bamboo viscose beach towel.
description: Oversized 180×90cm beach towel woven from soft bamboo viscose. Quick-drying, sand-shrugging and reversible with a sun-print front and a sandy-stripe back.

name: Floral Wrap Maxi Dress
shortDescription: Flowy maxi wrap with a hand-painted hibiscus print.
description: A flowing wrap maxi in lightweight rayon with a hand-painted hibiscus print. Adjustable tie waist for a custom fit, deep side pockets and a flutter sleeve that catches every coastal breeze.

name: Insulated Coconut Tumbler 24oz
shortDescription: 24oz double-walled tumbler keeps drinks cold 24 hours.
description: Triple-insulated stainless steel tumbler keeps icy coconut water cold for 24 hours and hot drinks hot for 12. Sweat-proof, dishwasher safe and leak-locked for backpack life.

name: Straw Wide-Brim Sun Hat
shortDescription: UPF 50+ packable straw hat with adjustable chin strap.
description: Hand-woven raffia straw hat with a wide 12cm brim, UPF 50+ rating and a packable crown that bounces back after every suitcase. Adjustable inner band and detachable chin strap included.

name: Performance Board Shorts
shortDescription: 4-way stretch board shorts with quick-dry recycled fabric.
description: 4-way stretch board shorts cut from 100% recycled ocean-bound polyester. Welded seams reduce chafe, the back zip pocket secures keys and the tie waist locks in even on the biggest sets.

name: Hydrating Aloe Mist 200ml
shortDescription: Cooling aloe and cucumber mist for sun-stressed skin.
description: A cooling face and body mist with organic aloe vera, cucumber extract and a touch of rose hyaluronic acid. Spritz after sun for instant calm and lasting hydration.

name: Foldable Beach Lounger
description: Lightweight aluminum frame, 600D weather-resistant fabric and 5 reclining positions. Folds flat in seconds with an integrated shoulder strap and a cooler-cup pocket on the armrest.

name: Tropical Print Bikini Set
shortDescription: Reversible tropical bikini in soft recycled nylon.
description: A reversible bikini in chlorine-resistant recycled nylon. Wear the tropical print one day, the solid coral the next. Adjustable ties and removable cups for a custom fit.

name: Waterproof Beach Speaker
shortDescription: IPX7 floating Bluetooth speaker with 16-hour battery.
description: Float-friendly IPX7 waterproof Bluetooth speaker. 16 hours of crisp summer playlists, sand-proof grills and a built-in carabiner for cooler-handle clipping.

name: Coconut Lip Balm Trio
shortDescription: SPF 30 lip balms in coconut, mango and watermelon.
description: Three SPF 30 lip balms — coconut, mango, watermelon — packed with shea butter and vitamin E. The trio fits any beach-bag side pocket.

name: Slip-on Espadrilles
shortDescription: Hand-stitched canvas espadrilles with jute soles.
description: Hand-stitched canvas espadrilles built on a real woven-jute sole. Padded insole, breathable upper and a slip-on fit that's perfect for boardwalk to bistro.

name: UPF 50+ Rash Guard
shortDescription: Long-sleeve UPF 50+ rash guard for surfers.
description: Long-sleeve UPF 50+ rash guard in chlorine-safe recycled poly-spandex. Flatlock seams keep paddling chafe-free; the thumb loops keep your hands covered for sun-long sessions.

name: Citronella Travel Candle
shortDescription: Soy-wax citronella candle in a reusable tin.
description: Hand-poured soy-wax citronella candle in a re-sealable travel tin. 25-hour burn, mosquito-deterring blend with cedar and lemongrass for breezy backyard nights.
